cv.summary: Full-stack developer with 9+ years of experience in .NET applications, frontend development, cloud integrations, and database optimization. I work across C#, Angular, Blazor, SQL, Azure, and AWS, with experience in Agile delivery, clean architecture, system migrations, and production support.

experience.title: Senior Backend Engineer
experience.details:
Maintained and enhanced a microservice-based e-commerce platform serving multiple countries, including payment integrations.
Developed SOAP and REST APIs with .NET and .NET Core, repository patterns, Dapper, and EF Core; built background services and triggers.
Migrated legacy .NET Framework projects to .NET Core and databases from AWS EC2 to RDS; optimized queries and addressed API vulnerabilities.
Integrated AWS Lambda, SQS, SNS, and EventBridge, plus Azure Event Hub and Service Bus.
Created and maintained CI/CD pipelines with TeamCity and Octopus Deploy; monitored production with New Relic.
Created internal NuGet packages, shared libraries, and console automation tools; maintained Elasticsearch and the Insider platform.

experience.title: Full Stack .NET Developer
experience.details:
Delivered eight enterprise web solutions across marine, insurance, education, transportation, healthcare/pharmaceuticals, renewable energy, retail/e-commerce, and ERP domains.
Developed ASP.NET and ASP.NET Core applications and REST APIs using CQRS and EF Core.
Built Angular/TypeScript and Blazor frontends and mobile applications with Power Apps.
Applied test-driven development with at least 50% code coverage and created API test automation with Postman.
Integrated Azure Blob Storage, Data Factory, and Functions, plus Google Pub/Sub, Kafka, SMS, and email services.
Managed Azure DevOps and GitLab pipelines; configured Dockerfiles and troubleshot Kubernetes pods.
Supported WCAG certification and development-process improvements; integrated LaunchDarkly and GraphQL-based authorization with MSAL token refresh.
Monitored applications with Datadog and Rancher.

experience.title: Web Developer
experience.details:
Developed and maintained in-house ASP.NET tools and integrations with web services and third-party REST APIs.
Deployed and configured .NET applications in IIS; administered SQL Server databases, queries, and stored procedures.
Built interfaces with Bootstrap 4 and Angular/TypeScript; remotely administered servers and investigated performance under load.

experience.title: Digital Developer
experience.details:
Built HTML5 rich-media interactive advertisements with JavaScript, CSS, and GSAP animations.
Integrated video-engagement and advertising metrics tracking; ensured mobile responsiveness and cross-browser compatibility.

experience.title: Junior Programmer
experience.details:
Developed web and Windows point-of-sale modules and supported a real-time web bidding platform.
Designed interfaces and automated POS configuration; improved website security and supported technical discussions and API integrations.

experience.title: Technical Support
experience.details: Worked part-time while studying, supporting customers of a US government-program mobile service provider with troubleshooting, documentation, and enrollment.

experience.title: TSR/CSR
experience.details: Worked part-time while studying, providing technical support and customer service for a US satellite television provider, including signal, remote-control, and billing issues.
